help: usage: fleet-switchboard merge-ready [-h] [--override WHO: REASON] pr Reads the pull request (GET only) and says READY (exit 0) only when its base is the default branch, no review at any commit requested changes or blocked (a dismissed request for changes or block counts as refused and names who dismissed it; a dismissed approval is a note), the repository's required hold label is present and every required check is green at the head. Otherwise one line per failed fact, exit 1. --override records an owner-ordered merge in the local audit (exit 6). positional arguments: pr The pull request: owner/repo#N or its URL options: -h, --help show this help message and exit --override WHO: REASON Record an owner-ordered fix-forward merge by name: one line in the switchboard audit, OVERRIDDEN printed, exit 6
